question: Find the name and nationality of the youngest driver who has ever set the fastest lap at the Austrian Grand Prix circuit, along with the year and date of that race.

WITH fastest_laps AS (
    SELECT 
        r.XCL_065 AS race_id,
        r.XCL_066 AS race_year,
        r.XCL_070 AS race_date,
        res.XCL_075 AS driver_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.XCL_065 ORDER BY 
            (CAST(SUBSTR(res.XCL_088, 1, INSTR(res.XCL_088, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60)
            + (CAST(SUBSTR(res.XCL_088, INSTR(res.XCL_088, ':') + 1, INSTR(res.XCL_088, '.') - INSTR(res.XCL_088, ':') - 1) AS REAL))
            + (CAST(SUBSTR(res.XCL_088, INSTR(res.XCL_088, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) ASC) AS rn
    FROM races r
    INNER JOIN results res ON r.XCL_065 = res.XCL_074
    WHERE r.XCL_069 = 'Austrian Grand Prix'
      AND res.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    d.XCL_038 || ' ' || d.XCL_039 AS name,
    d.XCL_041 AS nationality,
    fl.race_year,
    fl.race_date
FROM fastest_laps fl
INNER JOIN drivers d ON fl.driver_id = d.XCL_034
WHERE fl.rn = 1
ORDER BY d.XCL_040 DESC
LIMIT 1
